## Summary

Describe the focused change and its user impact.

## Motivation

Explain the problem this solves and link the relevant issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `swift test` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots
- [ ] User-facing copy is updated in Italian, English, French and Spanish
- [ ] Installer, security and release impact has been reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private hosts, personal paths or production logs were added

## Release notes

State the user-visible release note, or write `None` for internal-only changes.
